rationale: Sharon's TheAgentic.Ai builds production-ready AI agent infrastructure for high-stakes industries like biotech and healthtech, while Louan applies deep learning and self-supervised methods to clinical neuroimaging problems at UCSF—a direct match between AI infrastructure and a domain expert solving real medical imaging challenges. Their complementary skills (Louan's ML research depth + Sharon's production AI systems) could explore how agent-based workflows improve clinical neuroimaging pipelines or diagnostic accuracy.
intro_message: Louan, meet Sharon — she builds production AI agent infrastructure for biotech and healthtech; you're solving clinical neuroimaging with deep learning at UCSF, and there's potential synergy in applying her infrastructure to your domain.
